## [POLICY:FINAL_SALE_NO_RETURNS] Final Sale Items

Items marked final sale at the time of purchase cannot be returned or exchanged. Final sale status may appear on the product page, cart, checkout page, receipt, or order confirmation.

Citation-friendly rule: Final sale items cannot be returned or exchanged.

Example: A clearance handbag marked "Final Sale" on the product page is not eligible for return or exchange because the final sale restriction was disclosed before purchase.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states the item was final sale, classify the case as ineligible unless the customer also reports damage, defect, wrong item, missing item, or another support-review issue.

## [POLICY:REFUND_ORIGINAL_PAYMENT] Refund Method

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method used for the purchase. Northstar Commerce does not issue cash refunds for purchases made by card, digital wallet, gift card, or store credit.

Citation-friendly rule: Approved refunds go to the original payment method.

Example: If a customer paid with a credit card, an approved refund is returned to that credit card. If a customer paid with store credit, an approved refund is returned as store credit.

Agent handling rule: Explain the refund method only after clarifying that refund approval depends on eligibility, inspection, and support review when applicable.

## [POLICY:REFUND_TIMING_AFTER_INSPECTION] Refund Timing

Approved refunds are processed 5 to 10 business days after Northstar Commerce receives and inspects the returned item. Bank, card issuer, and payment provider posting times may add additional time after Northstar Commerce processes the refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Refunds are processed 5 to 10 business days after inspection.

Example: If a returned item is inspected on Monday and approved, Northstar Commerce processes the refund within 5 to 10 business days after that inspection date.

Agent handling rule: Do not tell the customer a refund has been issued unless the system has that order status. In this project, the agent should describe policy timing only.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_FRAUD_ABUSE] Fraud Concerns And Repeat Abuse

Fraud concerns, repeat abuse, suspicious return patterns, altered receipts, mismatched order details, unusually frequent missing item claims, or suspected policy manipulation require human support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Fraud concerns and repeat abuse require human support review.

Example: A customer reports missing items on several recent orders or provides order details that do not match the claimed item. Support must review before any refund or replacement decision.

Agent handling rule: Do not accuse the customer of fraud. Escalate neutrally using phrases such as "This requires support review because the order details need verification."

## [POLICY:INSPECTION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_REFUND] Inspection Before Refund Approval

Northstar Commerce may inspect returned items before approving a refund. Inspection may verify item identity, condition, packaging, accessories, damage claims, and whether the return matches the reason provided.

Citation-friendly rule: Returned items may require inspection before refund approval.

Example: A customer returns headphones for buyer's remorse. Northstar Commerce may inspect that the headphones are unused, unworn, unwashed if applicable, and include original packaging and accessories before approving a refund.

Agent handling rule: If the customer asks whether they will definitely receive a refund, explain that refund approval may depend on inspection.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY] Inventory Availability For Exchanges

Exchanges depend on inventory availability. Northstar Commerce cannot guarantee that a requested size, color, style, or variant will be available when the exchange is processed.

Citation-friendly rule: Exchanges depend on inventory availability.

Example: A customer may qualify for a size exchange, but the requested replacement size may be out of stock. In that case, support may offer a return, refund, or store credit option based on the applicable policy.

Agent handling rule: Never guarantee a replacement item. If the customer asks whether a specific size or color is available, explain that inventory must be checked by the store system or support.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_POLICY_EXCEPTIONS] Policy Exception Requests

Requests for exceptions to return windows, final sale restrictions, personalized item restrictions, digital product restrictions, inspection outcomes, or shipping-fee rules require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not approve an exception.

Citation-friendly rule: Policy exception requests require human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return a final sale item because they did not notice the final sale label. The agent should explain the final sale rule and escalate if the customer wants an exception.

Agent handling rule: Set escalation required when the customer asks for an exception, override, special approval, supervisor decision, or one-time courtesy outside the stated policy.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_RESTRICTED_ITEMS] Exchange Restrictions

Items that are final sale, digital, downloadable, or personalized are not eligible for standard exchange unless a specific damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described issue requires support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted items are not eligible for standard exchange unless a support-review issue applies.

Example: A personalized hoodie cannot be exchanged for a different size because the customer chose the wrong size. If the hoodie arrived with the wrong customization, support review is required.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests involving restricted items, apply restricted-item rules before standard exchange rules.

## [POLICY:EXCEPTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED] Exceptions To Restricted Item Rules

Exceptions to final sale, personalized item, digital product, or downloadable product restrictions require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not promise an exception, refund, exchange, store credit, or replacement.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted item exceptions require human support review and cannot be approved automatically by the agent.

Example: A customer asks for an exception because they missed the final sale disclosure. The agent should explain that final sale items are not returnable or exchangeable and route the exception request to support review if the customer wants further consideration.

Agent handling rule: If the customer requests an exception to a restricted-item rule, set escalation required and summarize the policy restriction, customer reason, and any supporting facts.

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_WRONG_MISSING_REVIEW] Support Review Required

Damaged, defective, missing, wrong item, and not-as-described cases usually require support review before a refund, replacement, exchange, or shipping-fee refund can be approved. Support may need to inspect photos, order records, carrier information, inventory records, and fulfillment notes.

Citation-friendly rule: Damaged, defective, missing, wrong item, and not-as-described cases usually require support review.

Example: A customer reports receiving a cracked vase. The case should be routed to support review because support may need photos and order verification before approving a refund or replacement.

Agent handling rule: Do not mark these cases as automatically eligible for refund or exchange. Set escalation required or route to support review, especially when responsibility is unclear.

## [POLICY:RESTRICTED_ITEM_FACTS] Required Facts For Restricted Items

For restricted-item cases, Northstar Commerce support needs the order number, item name, restriction type, customer reason, and whether the item is damaged, defective, incorrect, missing, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted-item review requires order details, restriction type, customer reason, and issue type.

Example: "My custom mug arrived with the wrong name" should collect the order number, photo or description of the incorrect customization, and issue type before support review.

Agent handling rule: Ask for missing restricted-item review facts before escalation when possible, but do not delay escalation if the customer has already provided enough facts to show review is required.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_AGGRESSIVE_LANGUAGE] Aggressive Or Unsafe Language

Aggressive language, harassment, threats of harm, abusive messages, or unsafe language toward support staff require human review and may require safety handling.

Citation-friendly rule: Aggressive, abusive, threatening, or unsafe language requires human review.

Example: A customer threatens a support employee while demanding a refund. The agent should not continue normal policy negotiation and should escalate.

Agent handling rule: Respond briefly, avoid escalation of tone, and route the case to human review.

## [POLICY:PERSONALIZED_CUSTOM_ITEMS] Personalized And Customized Items

Personalized, monogrammed, engraved, altered, made-to-order, or customized items cannot be returned or exchanged unless the item arrived damaged, defective, incorrect, or not as described by Northstar Commerce.

Citation-friendly rule: Personalized and customized items are not returnable unless damaged, defective, incorrect, or not as described.

Example: A necklace engraved with the customer's initials cannot be returned because the customer changed their mind. If the engraving is incorrect due to a Northstar Commerce error, the case requires support review.

Agent handling rule: If the item is personalized or customized, ask whether the issue is damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described. Escalate cases involving alleged Northstar Commerce error.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_HIGH_VALUE_REFUNDS] High-Value Refunds Over 500 Dollars

Refund requests over $500 require human support review before approval. High-value cases may require additional identity, order, payment, shipping, and inspection verification.

Citation-friendly rule: Refund requests over $500 require human support review before approval.

Example: A customer requests a $749 refund for an electronics order. Even if the customer provides order details, support review is required before approval.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states or implies the refund value is over $500, set escalation required. If item value is unknown and the product category may be high-value, ask for order value or route to review if other escalation factors are present.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_LEGAL_THREATS] Legal Threats And Regulatory Claims

Legal threats, regulatory complaints, chargeback threats, lawsuit references, attorney involvement, or claims that Northstar Commerce violated the law require immediate human support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Legal threats and regulatory claims require immediate human support review.

Example: A customer says they will sue Northstar Commerce unless a refund is issued. The agent should not debate legal issues and should escalate.

Agent handling rule: Keep the response calm and concise. Do not provide legal advice, assess legal merit, or make commitments. Escalate with the exact customer concern summarized neutrally.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_POLICY_EXCEPTIONS] Policy Exception Requests

Requests for exceptions to return windows, final sale restrictions, personalized item restrictions, digital product restrictions, inspection outcomes, or shipping-fee rules require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not approve an exception.

Citation-friendly rule: Policy exception requests require human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return a final sale item because they did not notice the final sale label. The agent should explain the final sale rule and escalate if the customer wants an exception.

Agent handling rule: Set escalation required when the customer asks for an exception, override, special approval, supervisor decision, or one-time courtesy outside the stated policy.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_WINDOW] Standard 30-Day Return Window

Most items purchased from Northstar Commerce can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The 30-day period begins on the date the carrier marks the item as delivered, not the order date.

Citation-friendly rule: Northstar Commerce accepts most eligible returns within 30 days of delivery.

Example: If an order was delivered on June 1, the customer may request a standard return through June 30, provided the item also meets condition and proof-of-purchase requirements.

Agent handling rule: If the customer asks whether an item can be returned and does not provide the delivery date, ask for the delivery date before making a final eligibility decision.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_SIZE_COLOR_WINDOW] Size And Color Exchanges

Size and color exchanges are allowed within 30 days of delivery when the item is otherwise eligible for return or exchange. The item must meet the same condition, packaging, and proof requirements that apply to standard returns unless support approves another path.

Citation-friendly rule: Size and color exchanges are allowed within 30 days when the item is eligible.

Example: A customer who bought a shirt in medium may request a large within 30 days of delivery if the shirt is unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, and supported by proof of purchase.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests, check the 30-day delivery window, item eligibility, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase before giving a decision.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_REASON] Standard Customer-Initiated Return Reasons

Standard return reasons include wrong size, changed mind, ordered by mistake, color preference, duplicate order, or buyer's remorse. These reasons may qualify for a return only if the item is within the return window, meets condition requirements, and has proof of purchase.

Citation-friendly rule: Buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, and ordered-by-mistake returns are standard customer-initiated returns subject to the 30-day window, condition rules, and proof-of-purchase requirement.

Example: A customer who ordered two sizes and wants to return one may qualify if the returned item is unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, within 30 days of delivery, and supported by proof of purchase.

Agent handling rule: For standard customer-initiated reasons, check return window, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase before deciding.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_DECISION_BOUNDARY] Decision Boundary For Standard Returns

A standard return may be marked eligible only when the customer provides facts showing that the item is within 30 days of delivery, unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, and supported by proof of purchase. If any required fact is unknown, the correct decision is `needs_more_info`, not `eligible`.

Citation-friendly rule: The agent must not mark a standard return eligible unless return window, item condition, packaging, and proof of purchase are all satisfied.

Example: "I bought shoes last month. Can I return them?" is missing delivery date, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase. The correct response is to ask for those facts.

Agent handling rule: Do not infer missing eligibility facts from friendly wording or customer confidence. Ask targeted follow-up questions.

## [POLICY:PROOF_OF_PURCHASE_REQUIRED] Proof Of Purchase Requirement

Northstar Commerce requires an order number, receipt, gift receipt, or other proof of purchase for standard returns. Proof of purchase is used to verify the purchase date, delivery date, item price, payment method, and return eligibility.

Citation-friendly rule: A standard return requires an order number or proof of purchase.

Example: A customer who provides an order number can be evaluated under the standard return policy. A customer who cannot provide any proof of purchase may still be reviewed by support, but the agent must not promise a refund.

Agent handling rule: If proof of purchase is missing, ask for an order number, receipt, or gift receipt. If the customer cannot provide proof, classify the case as needing support review rather than eligible.

## [POLICY:EXCEPTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED] Exceptions To Restricted Item Rules

Exceptions to final sale, personalized item, digital product, or downloadable product restrictions require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not promise an exception, refund, exchange, store credit, or replacement.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted item exceptions require human support review and cannot be approved automatically by the agent.

Example: A customer asks for an exception because they missed the final sale disclosure. The agent should explain that final sale items are not returnable or exchangeable and route the exception request to support review if the customer wants further consideration.

Agent handling rule: If the customer requests an exception to a restricted-item rule, set escalation required and summarize the policy restriction, customer reason, and any supporting facts.

## [POLICY:GIFT_RETURN_REQUIREMENTS] Gift Return Requirements

Gift returns require a gift receipt, order number, or other proof that the item was purchased from Northstar Commerce. Gift returns must also satisfy applicable return window, item condition, packaging, and restricted-item rules.

Citation-friendly rule: Gift returns require a gift receipt or order number.

Example: A customer returning a gifted scarf should provide the gift receipt or order number so Northstar Commerce can verify eligibility.

Agent handling rule: If the customer says the item was a gift and does not provide a gift receipt or order number, ask for one before making an eligibility decision.

## [POLICY:FINAL_SALE_NO_RETURNS] Final Sale Items

Items marked final sale at the time of purchase cannot be returned or exchanged. Final sale status may appear on the product page, cart, checkout page, receipt, or order confirmation.

Citation-friendly rule: Final sale items cannot be returned or exchanged.

Example: A clearance handbag marked "Final Sale" on the product page is not eligible for return or exchange because the final sale restriction was disclosed before purchase.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states the item was final sale, classify the case as ineligible unless the customer also reports damage, defect, wrong item, missing item, or another support-review issue.

## [POLICY:STORE_CREDIT_WITH_MISSING_PROOF] Store Credit When Proof Is Missing

When proof of purchase is missing, Northstar Commerce support may approve store credit instead of a refund to the original payment method. Store credit for missing-proof cases is discretionary and requires support approval.

Citation-friendly rule: Store credit may be issued when proof of purchase is missing but support approves.

Example: A customer without a receipt may be routed to support review. Support may approve store credit if the item can be verified and the return is otherwise acceptable.

Agent handling rule: Do not promise store credit. If proof is missing, explain that support review is required and store credit may be possible only if support approves.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_HANDOFF_SUMMARY] Handoff Summary Requirements

When escalating, the agent should prepare a handoff summary containing customer request, order number if provided, item name, delivery date if known, issue type, requested outcome, known facts, missing facts, relevant policy IDs, and reason for escalation.

Citation-friendly rule: Escalations should include a handoff summary with known facts, missing facts, relevant policy IDs, and escalation reason.

Example: "Customer requests refund for order NC-2002, personalized blanket, wrong embroidered name, photo available. Relevant policies: personalized item exception and support review required."

Agent handling rule: Every escalation response should include a concise customer-facing explanation and a structured handoff summary for support.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_ITEM_CONDITION] Item Condition Requirements

To qualify for a standard return, an item must be unused, unworn, unwashed, and in its original packaging. Original packaging includes manufacturer boxes, product tags, accessories, manuals, protective materials, and included parts when those materials were provided with the item.

Citation-friendly rule: Standard returns require the item to be unused, unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging.

Example: A jacket that still has tags attached and has not been worn outside may qualify for a standard return. A jacket that has been worn, washed, or returned without required accessories may be ineligible or require support review.

Agent handling rule: If the customer describes use, wear, washing, missing tags, missing accessories, or missing packaging, do not approve the return automatically. Ask for the item condition or route to escalation if the policy outcome is unclear.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_MISSING_PROOF_HIGH_VALUE] Missing Proof With High-Value Items

Missing proof of purchase for high-value items requires human support review. The agent must not offer refunds, replacements, exchanges, or store credit for high-value items without proof of purchase.

Citation-friendly rule: Missing proof of purchase with high-value items requires human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return expensive headphones but has no receipt, order number, or gift receipt. Support must review before any outcome is offered.

Agent handling rule: Ask for proof of purchase first. If proof remains unavailable and the item appears high-value, escalate.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_RESTRICTED_ITEMS] Exchange Restrictions

Items that are final sale, digital, downloadable, or personalized are not eligible for standard exchange unless a specific damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described issue requires support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted items are not eligible for standard exchange unless a support-review issue applies.

Example: A personalized hoodie cannot be exchanged for a different size because the customer chose the wrong size. If the hoodie arrived with the wrong customization, support review is required.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests involving restricted items, apply restricted-item rules before standard exchange rules.

## [POLICY:GIFT_REFUND_STORE_CREDIT] Gift Refund Method

Gift returns are usually refunded as Northstar Commerce store credit. Store credit may be issued to the gift recipient when support verifies the gift purchase and approves the return.

Citation-friendly rule: Gift returns are usually refunded as store credit.

Example: A gift recipient who returns an eligible item with a gift receipt may receive store credit rather than a refund to the purchaser's original payment method.

Agent handling rule: Explain that gift returns usually result in store credit, but do not promise store credit until eligibility and support approval are confirmed.

## [POLICY:RESTRICTED_ITEM_FACTS] Required Facts For Restricted Items

For restricted-item cases, Northstar Commerce support needs the order number, item name, restriction type, customer reason, and whether the item is damaged, defective, incorrect, missing, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted-item review requires order details, restriction type, customer reason, and issue type.

Example: "My custom mug arrived with the wrong name" should collect the order number, photo or description of the incorrect customization, and issue type before support review.

Agent handling rule: Ask for missing restricted-item review facts before escalation when possible, but do not delay escalation if the customer has already provided enough facts to show review is required.

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_WRONG_MISSING_REQUIRED_INFO] Required Information For Issue Review

Customers reporting damaged, defective, missing, wrong, or not-as-described items must provide an order number, a photo or clear description of the issue, and the issue type. Issue type should be one of damaged, defective, missing item, wrong item, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Issue review requires order number, photo or description, and issue type.

Example: "My lamp arrived broken" is missing the order number and photo or description details. "Order NC-1007 arrived with a broken lamp base, and I can upload a photo" includes the order number, issue type, and supporting description.

Agent handling rule: If any required information is missing, ask for it. If the customer provides enough information, escalate with a handoff summary.

## [POLICY:STORE_CREDIT_USE] Store Credit Scope

Northstar Commerce store credit may be used for future Northstar Commerce purchases subject to the terms provided when the credit is issued. Store credit is not the same as a cash refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Store credit may be used for future Northstar Commerce purchases and is not a cash refund.

Example: A customer who receives store credit for a gift return can apply that credit to a future purchase from Northstar Commerce.

Agent handling rule: When explaining store credit, distinguish it from original-payment refunds and avoid promising transferability, cash redemption, or expiration terms unless those terms are present in the available policy documents.

## [POLICY:RETURN_SHIPPING_NORTHSTAR_REASONS] Return Shipping For Northstar Or Fulfillment Issues

Return shipping may be refunded when the return reason is damaged, defective, wrong item, missing item, or not as described. Support review may be required before approving the shipping-fee refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Return shipping may be refunded for damaged, defective, wrong, missing, or not-as-described items.

Example: A customer received the wrong color due to fulfillment error. Support may approve return shipping reimbursement after reviewing the order and issue evidence.

Agent handling rule: If the customer reports a Northstar or fulfillment issue, do not guarantee shipping reimbursement. Explain that return shipping may be refunded after support review.

## [POLICY:REFUND_ORIGINAL_PAYMENT] Refund Method

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method used for the purchase. Northstar Commerce does not issue cash refunds for purchases made by card, digital wallet, gift card, or store credit.

Citation-friendly rule: Approved refunds go to the original payment method.

Example: If a customer paid with a credit card, an approved refund is returned to that credit card. If a customer paid with store credit, an approved refund is returned as store credit.

Agent handling rule: Explain the refund method only after clarifying that refund approval depends on eligibility, inspection, and support review when applicable.

## [POLICY:WRONG_ITEM_RECEIVED] Wrong Item Received

A wrong item case occurs when the customer receives a different product, size, color, quantity, or variant than what appears on the order confirmation. Wrong item cases require order verification and may require a photo of the item received and packing slip.

Citation-friendly rule: Wrong item cases require order verification and may require a photo of the received item and packing slip.

Example: A customer ordered black running shoes in size 9 but received blue running shoes in size 8. Support must verify the order and item received before approving a replacement or return.

Agent handling rule: Ask for the order number, the item ordered, the item received, and a photo or description. Escalate once those facts are available.

## [POLICY:RETURN_SHIPPING_CUSTOMER_REASONS] Return Shipping For Customer-Initiated Reasons

Return shipping is not refunded for buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, color preference, duplicate order, or ordered-by-mistake returns. These are customer-initiated reasons.

Citation-friendly rule: Return shipping is not refunded for buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, or ordered by mistake.

Example: A customer returns a sweater because they ordered the wrong size. If the return is otherwise eligible, the original return shipping cost is not refunded under the customer-initiated reason rule.

Agent handling rule: If the reason is customer-initiated, cite this rule when explaining shipping fee responsibility.

## [POLICY:INSPECTION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_REFUND] Inspection Before Refund Approval

Northstar Commerce may inspect returned items before approving a refund. Inspection may verify item identity, condition, packaging, accessories, damage claims, and whether the return matches the reason provided.

Citation-friendly rule: Returned items may require inspection before refund approval.

Example: A customer returns headphones for buyer's remorse. Northstar Commerce may inspect that the headphones are unused, unworn, unwashed if applicable, and include original packaging and accessories before approving a refund.

Agent handling rule: If the customer asks whether they will definitely receive a refund, explain that refund approval may depend on inspection.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_HIGH_VALUE_REFUNDS] High-Value Refunds Over 500 Dollars

Refund requests over $500 require human support review before approval. High-value cases may require additional identity, order, payment, shipping, and inspection verification.

Citation-friendly rule: Refund requests over $500 require human support review before approval.

Example: A customer requests a $749 refund for an electronics order. Even if the customer provides order details, support review is required before approval.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states or implies the refund value is over $500, set escalation required. If item value is unknown and the product category may be high-value, ask for order value or route to review if other escalation factors are present.

## [POLICY:MISSING_ITEMS] Missing Item Claims

A missing item case occurs when an item listed on the order confirmation or packing slip was not included in the delivered package. Missing item cases require order number, item name, package condition, and a description of what was received.

Citation-friendly rule: Missing item claims require order number, item name, package condition, and description of what was received.

Example: A customer ordered three candles but received only two. Support must review the order and fulfillment records before deciding whether to send the missing item or issue a refund.

Agent handling rule: Escalate missing item claims because they may require fulfillment and carrier review. Ask for package condition if the customer did not provide it.

## [POLICY:REFUND_TIMING_AFTER_INSPECTION] Refund Timing

Approved refunds are processed 5 to 10 business days after Northstar Commerce receives and inspects the returned item. Bank, card issuer, and payment provider posting times may add additional time after Northstar Commerce processes the refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Refunds are processed 5 to 10 business days after inspection.

Example: If a returned item is inspected on Monday and approved, Northstar Commerce processes the refund within 5 to 10 business days after that inspection date.

Agent handling rule: Do not tell the customer a refund has been issued unless the system has that order status. In this project, the agent should describe policy timing only.

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_WRONG_MISSING_REVIEW] Support Review Required

Damaged, defective, missing, wrong item, and not-as-described cases usually require support review before a refund, replacement, exchange, or shipping-fee refund can be approved. Support may need to inspect photos, order records, carrier information, inventory records, and fulfillment notes.

Citation-friendly rule: Damaged, defective, missing, wrong item, and not-as-described cases usually require support review.

Example: A customer reports receiving a cracked vase. The case should be routed to support review because support may need photos and order verification before approving a refund or replacement.

Agent handling rule: Do not mark these cases as automatically eligible for refund or exchange. Set escalation required or route to support review, especially when responsibility is unclear.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_DAMAGE_RESPONSIBILITY] Unclear Damaged-Item Responsibility

Cases where damaged-item responsibility is unclear require human support review. This includes damage discovered after use, damage reported long after delivery, unclear carrier involvement, unclear customer handling, or conflict between the customer's account and order records.

Citation-friendly rule: Unclear damaged-item responsibility requires human support review.

Example: A customer says a chair broke after several weeks but does not know whether it arrived damaged. Support must review timing, photos, item use, and delivery records before deciding.

Agent handling rule: Escalate and collect delivery date, date issue was noticed, photos or description, package condition, and how the item was used.

## [POLICY:PERSONALIZED_CUSTOM_ITEMS] Personalized And Customized Items

Personalized, monogrammed, engraved, altered, made-to-order, or customized items cannot be returned or exchanged unless the item arrived damaged, defective, incorrect, or not as described by Northstar Commerce.

Citation-friendly rule: Personalized and customized items are not returnable unless damaged, defective, incorrect, or not as described.

Example: A necklace engraved with the customer's initials cannot be returned because the customer changed their mind. If the engraving is incorrect due to a Northstar Commerce error, the case requires support review.

Agent handling rule: If the item is personalized or customized, ask whether the issue is damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described. Escalate cases involving alleged Northstar Commerce error.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY] Inventory Availability For Exchanges

Exchanges depend on inventory availability. Northstar Commerce cannot guarantee that a requested size, color, style, or variant will be available when the exchange is processed.

Citation-friendly rule: Exchanges depend on inventory availability.

Example: A customer may qualify for a size exchange, but the requested replacement size may be out of stock. In that case, support may offer a return, refund, or store credit option based on the applicable policy.

Agent handling rule: Never guarantee a replacement item. If the customer asks whether a specific size or color is available, explain that inventory must be checked by the store system or support.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_AGGRESSIVE_LANGUAGE] Aggressive Or Unsafe Language

Aggressive language, harassment, threats of harm, abusive messages, or unsafe language toward support staff require human review and may require safety handling.

Citation-friendly rule: Aggressive, abusive, threatening, or unsafe language requires human review.

Example: A customer threatens a support employee while demanding a refund. The agent should not continue normal policy negotiation and should escalate.

Agent handling rule: Respond briefly, avoid escalation of tone, and route the case to human review.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_LEGAL_THREATS] Legal Threats And Regulatory Claims

Legal threats, regulatory complaints, chargeback threats, lawsuit references, attorney involvement, or claims that Northstar Commerce violated the law require immediate human support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Legal threats and regulatory claims require immediate human support review.

Example: A customer says they will sue Northstar Commerce unless a refund is issued. The agent should not debate legal issues and should escalate.

Agent handling rule: Keep the response calm and concise. Do not provide legal advice, assess legal merit, or make commitments. Escalate with the exact customer concern summarized neutrally.

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_RESPONSIBILITY_UNCLEAR] Unclear Responsibility

When it is unclear whether damage was caused by shipping, customer handling, product defect, carrier handling, or normal wear after delivery, the case requires human review. The agent must not assign responsibility.

Citation-friendly rule: Unclear damaged-item responsibility requires human review.

Example: A customer says a table "broke after two weeks" but does not explain whether it arrived damaged or broke during use. Support review is required before deciding responsibility.

Agent handling rule: Escalate unclear responsibility cases and ask for delivery date, when the issue was first noticed, item condition on arrival, photos, and description of use.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_POLICY_EXCEPTIONS] Policy Exception Requests

Requests for exceptions to return windows, final sale restrictions, personalized item restrictions, digital product restrictions, inspection outcomes, or shipping-fee rules require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not approve an exception.

Citation-friendly rule: Policy exception requests require human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return a final sale item because they did not notice the final sale label. The agent should explain the final sale rule and escalate if the customer wants an exception.

Agent handling rule: Set escalation required when the customer asks for an exception, override, special approval, supervisor decision, or one-time courtesy outside the stated policy.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_WINDOW] Standard 30-Day Return Window

Most items purchased from Northstar Commerce can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The 30-day period begins on the date the carrier marks the item as delivered, not the order date.

Citation-friendly rule: Northstar Commerce accepts most eligible returns within 30 days of delivery.

Example: If an order was delivered on June 1, the customer may request a standard return through June 30, provided the item also meets condition and proof-of-purchase requirements.

Agent handling rule: If the customer asks whether an item can be returned and does not provide the delivery date, ask for the delivery date before making a final eligibility decision.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_SIZE_COLOR_WINDOW] Size And Color Exchanges

Size and color exchanges are allowed within 30 days of delivery when the item is otherwise eligible for return or exchange. The item must meet the same condition, packaging, and proof requirements that apply to standard returns unless support approves another path.

Citation-friendly rule: Size and color exchanges are allowed within 30 days when the item is eligible.

Example: A customer who bought a shirt in medium may request a large within 30 days of delivery if the shirt is unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, and supported by proof of purchase.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests, check the 30-day delivery window, item eligibility, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase before giving a decision.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_REASON] Standard Customer-Initiated Return Reasons

Standard return reasons include wrong size, changed mind, ordered by mistake, color preference, duplicate order, or buyer's remorse. These reasons may qualify for a return only if the item is within the return window, meets condition requirements, and has proof of purchase.

Citation-friendly rule: Buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, and ordered-by-mistake returns are standard customer-initiated returns subject to the 30-day window, condition rules, and proof-of-purchase requirement.

Example: A customer who ordered two sizes and wants to return one may qualify if the returned item is unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, within 30 days of delivery, and supported by proof of purchase.

Agent handling rule: For standard customer-initiated reasons, check return window, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase before deciding.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_DECISION_BOUNDARY] Decision Boundary For Standard Returns

A standard return may be marked eligible only when the customer provides facts showing that the item is within 30 days of delivery, unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, and supported by proof of purchase. If any required fact is unknown, the correct decision is `needs_more_info`, not `eligible`.

Citation-friendly rule: The agent must not mark a standard return eligible unless return window, item condition, packaging, and proof of purchase are all satisfied.

Example: "I bought shoes last month. Can I return them?" is missing delivery date, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase. The correct response is to ask for those facts.

Agent handling rule: Do not infer missing eligibility facts from friendly wording or customer confidence. Ask targeted follow-up questions.

## [POLICY:PROOF_OF_PURCHASE_REQUIRED] Proof Of Purchase Requirement

Northstar Commerce requires an order number, receipt, gift receipt, or other proof of purchase for standard returns. Proof of purchase is used to verify the purchase date, delivery date, item price, payment method, and return eligibility.

Citation-friendly rule: A standard return requires an order number or proof of purchase.

Example: A customer who provides an order number can be evaluated under the standard return policy. A customer who cannot provide any proof of purchase may still be reviewed by support, but the agent must not promise a refund.

Agent handling rule: If proof of purchase is missing, ask for an order number, receipt, or gift receipt. If the customer cannot provide proof, classify the case as needing support review rather than eligible.

## [POLICY:EXCEPTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED] Exceptions To Restricted Item Rules

Exceptions to final sale, personalized item, digital product, or downloadable product restrictions require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not promise an exception, refund, exchange, store credit, or replacement.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted item exceptions require human support review and cannot be approved automatically by the agent.

Example: A customer asks for an exception because they missed the final sale disclosure. The agent should explain that final sale items are not returnable or exchangeable and route the exception request to support review if the customer wants further consideration.

Agent handling rule: If the customer requests an exception to a restricted-item rule, set escalation required and summarize the policy restriction, customer reason, and any supporting facts.

## [POLICY:GIFT_RETURN_REQUIREMENTS] Gift Return Requirements

Gift returns require a gift receipt, order number, or other proof that the item was purchased from Northstar Commerce. Gift returns must also satisfy applicable return window, item condition, packaging, and restricted-item rules.

Citation-friendly rule: Gift returns require a gift receipt or order number.

Example: A customer returning a gifted scarf should provide the gift receipt or order number so Northstar Commerce can verify eligibility.

Agent handling rule: If the customer says the item was a gift and does not provide a gift receipt or order number, ask for one before making an eligibility decision.

## [POLICY:FINAL_SALE_NO_RETURNS] Final Sale Items

Items marked final sale at the time of purchase cannot be returned or exchanged. Final sale status may appear on the product page, cart, checkout page, receipt, or order confirmation.

Citation-friendly rule: Final sale items cannot be returned or exchanged.

Example: A clearance handbag marked "Final Sale" on the product page is not eligible for return or exchange because the final sale restriction was disclosed before purchase.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states the item was final sale, classify the case as ineligible unless the customer also reports damage, defect, wrong item, missing item, or another support-review issue.

## [POLICY:STORE_CREDIT_WITH_MISSING_PROOF] Store Credit When Proof Is Missing

When proof of purchase is missing, Northstar Commerce support may approve store credit instead of a refund to the original payment method. Store credit for missing-proof cases is discretionary and requires support approval.

Citation-friendly rule: Store credit may be issued when proof of purchase is missing but support approves.

Example: A customer without a receipt may be routed to support review. Support may approve store credit if the item can be verified and the return is otherwise acceptable.

Agent handling rule: Do not promise store credit. If proof is missing, explain that support review is required and store credit may be possible only if support approves.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_HANDOFF_SUMMARY] Handoff Summary Requirements

When escalating, the agent should prepare a handoff summary containing customer request, order number if provided, item name, delivery date if known, issue type, requested outcome, known facts, missing facts, relevant policy IDs, and reason for escalation.

Citation-friendly rule: Escalations should include a handoff summary with known facts, missing facts, relevant policy IDs, and escalation reason.

Example: "Customer requests refund for order NC-2002, personalized blanket, wrong embroidered name, photo available. Relevant policies: personalized item exception and support review required."

Agent handling rule: Every escalation response should include a concise customer-facing explanation and a structured handoff summary for support.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_ITEM_CONDITION] Item Condition Requirements

To qualify for a standard return, an item must be unused, unworn, unwashed, and in its original packaging. Original packaging includes manufacturer boxes, product tags, accessories, manuals, protective materials, and included parts when those materials were provided with the item.

Citation-friendly rule: Standard returns require the item to be unused, unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging.

Example: A jacket that still has tags attached and has not been worn outside may qualify for a standard return. A jacket that has been worn, washed, or returned without required accessories may be ineligible or require support review.

Agent handling rule: If the customer describes use, wear, washing, missing tags, missing accessories, or missing packaging, do not approve the return automatically. Ask for the item condition or route to escalation if the policy outcome is unclear.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_MISSING_PROOF_HIGH_VALUE] Missing Proof With High-Value Items

Missing proof of purchase for high-value items requires human support review. The agent must not offer refunds, replacements, exchanges, or store credit for high-value items without proof of purchase.

Citation-friendly rule: Missing proof of purchase with high-value items requires human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return expensive headphones but has no receipt, order number, or gift receipt. Support must review before any outcome is offered.

Agent handling rule: Ask for proof of purchase first. If proof remains unavailable and the item appears high-value, escalate.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_RESTRICTED_ITEMS] Exchange Restrictions

Items that are final sale, digital, downloadable, or personalized are not eligible for standard exchange unless a specific damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described issue requires support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted items are not eligible for standard exchange unless a support-review issue applies.

Example: A personalized hoodie cannot be exchanged for a different size because the customer chose the wrong size. If the hoodie arrived with the wrong customization, support review is required.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests involving restricted items, apply restricted-item rules before standard exchange rules.

## [POLICY:GIFT_REFUND_STORE_CREDIT] Gift Refund Method

Gift returns are usually refunded as Northstar Commerce store credit. Store credit may be issued to the gift recipient when support verifies the gift purchase and approves the return.

Citation-friendly rule: Gift returns are usually refunded as store credit.

Example: A gift recipient who returns an eligible item with a gift receipt may receive store credit rather than a refund to the purchaser's original payment method.

Agent handling rule: Explain that gift returns usually result in store credit, but do not promise store credit until eligibility and support approval are confirmed.

## [POLICY:RESTRICTED_ITEM_FACTS] Required Facts For Restricted Items

For restricted-item cases, Northstar Commerce support needs the order number, item name, restriction type, customer reason, and whether the item is damaged, defective, incorrect, missing, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted-item review requires order details, restriction type, customer reason, and issue type.

Example: "My custom mug arrived with the wrong name" should collect the order number, photo or description of the incorrect customization, and issue type before support review.

Agent handling rule: Ask for missing restricted-item review facts before escalation when possible, but do not delay escalation if the customer has already provided enough facts to show review is required.

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_WRONG_MISSING_REQUIRED_INFO] Required Information For Issue Review

Customers reporting damaged, defective, missing, wrong, or not-as-described items must provide an order number, a photo or clear description of the issue, and the issue type. Issue type should be one of damaged, defective, missing item, wrong item, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Issue review requires order number, photo or description, and issue type.

Example: "My lamp arrived broken" is missing the order number and photo or description details. "Order NC-1007 arrived with a broken lamp base, and I can upload a photo" includes the order number, issue type, and supporting description.

Agent handling rule: If any required information is missing, ask for it. If the customer provides enough information, escalate with a handoff summary.

## [POLICY:STORE_CREDIT_USE] Store Credit Scope

Northstar Commerce store credit may be used for future Northstar Commerce purchases subject to the terms provided when the credit is issued. Store credit is not the same as a cash refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Store credit may be used for future Northstar Commerce purchases and is not a cash refund.

Example: A customer who receives store credit for a gift return can apply that credit to a future purchase from Northstar Commerce.

Agent handling rule: When explaining store credit, distinguish it from original-payment refunds and avoid promising transferability, cash redemption, or expiration terms unless those terms are present in the available policy documents.

## [POLICY:RETURN_SHIPPING_NORTHSTAR_REASONS] Return Shipping For Northstar Or Fulfillment Issues

Return shipping may be refunded when the return reason is damaged, defective, wrong item, missing item, or not as described. Support review may be required before approving the shipping-fee refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Return shipping may be refunded for damaged, defective, wrong, missing, or not-as-described items.

Example: A customer received the wrong color due to fulfillment error. Support may approve return shipping reimbursement after reviewing the order and issue evidence.

Agent handling rule: If the customer reports a Northstar or fulfillment issue, do not guarantee shipping reimbursement. Explain that return shipping may be refunded after support review.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_AGGRESSIVE_LANGUAGE] Aggressive Or Unsafe Language

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_RESPONSIBILITY_UNCLEAR] Unclear Responsibility

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_POLICY_EXCEPTIONS] Policy Exception Requests

Requests for exceptions to return windows, final sale restrictions, personalized item restrictions, digital product restrictions, inspection outcomes, or shipping-fee rules require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not approve an exception.

Citation-friendly rule: Policy exception requests require human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return a final sale item because they did not notice the final sale label. The agent should explain the final sale rule and escalate if the customer wants an exception.

Agent handling rule: Set escalation required when the customer asks for an exception, override, special approval, supervisor decision, or one-time courtesy outside the stated policy.

## [POLICY:EXCEPTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED] Exceptions To Restricted Item Rules

Exceptions to final sale, personalized item, digital product, or downloadable product restrictions require human support review. The agent may explain the policy but must not promise an exception, refund, exchange, store credit, or replacement.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted item exceptions require human support review and cannot be approved automatically by the agent.

Example: A customer asks for an exception because they missed the final sale disclosure. The agent should explain that final sale items are not returnable or exchangeable and route the exception request to support review if the customer wants further consideration.

Agent handling rule: If the customer requests an exception to a restricted-item rule, set escalation required and summarize the policy restriction, customer reason, and any supporting facts.

## [POLICY:FINAL_SALE_NO_RETURNS] Final Sale Items

Items marked final sale at the time of purchase cannot be returned or exchanged. Final sale status may appear on the product page, cart, checkout page, receipt, or order confirmation.

Citation-friendly rule: Final sale items cannot be returned or exchanged.

Example: A clearance handbag marked "Final Sale" on the product page is not eligible for return or exchange because the final sale restriction was disclosed before purchase.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states the item was final sale, classify the case as ineligible unless the customer also reports damage, defect, wrong item, missing item, or another support-review issue.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_RESTRICTED_ITEMS] Exchange Restrictions

Items that are final sale, digital, downloadable, or personalized are not eligible for standard exchange unless a specific damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described issue requires support review.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted items are not eligible for standard exchange unless a support-review issue applies.

Example: A personalized hoodie cannot be exchanged for a different size because the customer chose the wrong size. If the hoodie arrived with the wrong customization, support review is required.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests involving restricted items, apply restricted-item rules before standard exchange rules.

## [POLICY:DIGITAL_PRODUCTS_NONRETURNABLE] Digital Gift Cards And Downloadable Products

Digital gift cards, downloadable products, digital codes, and electronically delivered content cannot be returned, exchanged, or refunded after delivery unless required by law or support confirms a Northstar Commerce fulfillment error.

Citation-friendly rule: Digital gift cards and downloadable products cannot be returned after delivery.

Example: A customer who downloaded a digital guide cannot return it because they no longer need it. A customer who received the wrong digital code should be routed to support review.

Agent handling rule: For digital products, do not offer a standard return path. Escalate only when the customer reports non-delivery, wrong code, duplicate charge, fulfillment error, or a legal compliance concern.

## [POLICY:PERSONALIZED_CUSTOM_ITEMS] Personalized And Customized Items

Personalized, monogrammed, engraved, altered, made-to-order, or customized items cannot be returned or exchanged unless the item arrived damaged, defective, incorrect, or not as described by Northstar Commerce.

Citation-friendly rule: Personalized and customized items are not returnable unless damaged, defective, incorrect, or not as described.

Example: A necklace engraved with the customer's initials cannot be returned because the customer changed their mind. If the engraving is incorrect due to a Northstar Commerce error, the case requires support review.

Agent handling rule: If the item is personalized or customized, ask whether the issue is damage, defect, wrong item, incorrect customization, or not-as-described. Escalate cases involving alleged Northstar Commerce error.

## [POLICY:RESTRICTED_ITEM_FACTS] Required Facts For Restricted Items

For restricted-item cases, Northstar Commerce support needs the order number, item name, restriction type, customer reason, and whether the item is damaged, defective, incorrect, missing, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Restricted-item review requires order details, restriction type, customer reason, and issue type.

Example: "My custom mug arrived with the wrong name" should collect the order number, photo or description of the incorrect customization, and issue type before support review.

Agent handling rule: Ask for missing restricted-item review facts before escalation when possible, but do not delay escalation if the customer has already provided enough facts to show review is required.

## [POLICY:EXCHANGE_SIZE_COLOR_WINDOW] Size And Color Exchanges

Size and color exchanges are allowed within 30 days of delivery when the item is otherwise eligible for return or exchange. The item must meet the same condition, packaging, and proof requirements that apply to standard returns unless support approves another path.

Citation-friendly rule: Size and color exchanges are allowed within 30 days when the item is eligible.

Example: A customer who bought a shirt in medium may request a large within 30 days of delivery if the shirt is unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, and supported by proof of purchase.

Agent handling rule: For exchange requests, check the 30-day delivery window, item eligibility, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase before giving a decision.

## [POLICY:GIFT_RETURN_REQUIREMENTS] Gift Return Requirements

Gift returns require a gift receipt, order number, or other proof that the item was purchased from Northstar Commerce. Gift returns must also satisfy applicable return window, item condition, packaging, and restricted-item rules.

Citation-friendly rule: Gift returns require a gift receipt or order number.

Example: A customer returning a gifted scarf should provide the gift receipt or order number so Northstar Commerce can verify eligibility.

Agent handling rule: If the customer says the item was a gift and does not provide a gift receipt or order number, ask for one before making an eligibility decision.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_HANDOFF_SUMMARY] Handoff Summary Requirements

When escalating, the agent should prepare a handoff summary containing customer request, order number if provided, item name, delivery date if known, issue type, requested outcome, known facts, missing facts, relevant policy IDs, and reason for escalation.

Citation-friendly rule: Escalations should include a handoff summary with known facts, missing facts, relevant policy IDs, and escalation reason.

Example: "Customer requests refund for order NC-2002, personalized blanket, wrong embroidered name, photo available. Relevant policies: personalized item exception and support review required."

Agent handling rule: Every escalation response should include a concise customer-facing explanation and a structured handoff summary for support.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_ITEM_CONDITION] Item Condition Requirements

To qualify for a standard return, an item must be unused, unworn, unwashed, and in its original packaging. Original packaging includes manufacturer boxes, product tags, accessories, manuals, protective materials, and included parts when those materials were provided with the item.

Citation-friendly rule: Standard returns require the item to be unused, unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging.

Example: A jacket that still has tags attached and has not been worn outside may qualify for a standard return. A jacket that has been worn, washed, or returned without required accessories may be ineligible or require support review.

Agent handling rule: If the customer describes use, wear, washing, missing tags, missing accessories, or missing packaging, do not approve the return automatically. Ask for the item condition or route to escalation if the policy outcome is unclear.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_DECISION_BOUNDARY] Decision Boundary For Standard Returns

A standard return may be marked eligible only when the customer provides facts showing that the item is within 30 days of delivery, unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, and supported by proof of purchase. If any required fact is unknown, the correct decision is `needs_more_info`, not `eligible`.

Citation-friendly rule: The agent must not mark a standard return eligible unless return window, item condition, packaging, and proof of purchase are all satisfied.

Example: "I bought shoes last month. Can I return them?" is missing delivery date, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase. The correct response is to ask for those facts.

Agent handling rule: Do not infer missing eligibility facts from friendly wording or customer confidence. Ask targeted follow-up questions.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_REASON] Standard Customer-Initiated Return Reasons

Standard return reasons include wrong size, changed mind, ordered by mistake, color preference, duplicate order, or buyer's remorse. These reasons may qualify for a return only if the item is within the return window, meets condition requirements, and has proof of purchase.

Citation-friendly rule: Buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, and ordered-by-mistake returns are standard customer-initiated returns subject to the 30-day window, condition rules, and proof-of-purchase requirement.

Example: A customer who ordered two sizes and wants to return one may qualify if the returned item is unused, unworn, unwashed, in original packaging, within 30 days of delivery, and supported by proof of purchase.

Agent handling rule: For standard customer-initiated reasons, check return window, condition, packaging, and proof of purchase before deciding.

## [POLICY:GIFT_REFUND_STORE_CREDIT] Gift Refund Method

Gift returns are usually refunded as Northstar Commerce store credit. Store credit may be issued to the gift recipient when support verifies the gift purchase and approves the return.

Citation-friendly rule: Gift returns are usually refunded as store credit.

Example: A gift recipient who returns an eligible item with a gift receipt may receive store credit rather than a refund to the purchaser's original payment method.

Agent handling rule: Explain that gift returns usually result in store credit, but do not promise store credit until eligibility and support approval are confirmed.

## [POLICY:STANDARD_RETURN_WINDOW] Standard 30-Day Return Window

Most items purchased from Northstar Commerce can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The 30-day period begins on the date the carrier marks the item as delivered, not the order date.

Citation-friendly rule: Northstar Commerce accepts most eligible returns within 30 days of delivery.

Example: If an order was delivered on June 1, the customer may request a standard return through June 30, provided the item also meets condition and proof-of-purchase requirements.

Agent handling rule: If the customer asks whether an item can be returned and does not provide the delivery date, ask for the delivery date before making a final eligibility decision.

## [POLICY:REFUND_ORIGINAL_PAYMENT] Refund Method

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method used for the purchase. Northstar Commerce does not issue cash refunds for purchases made by card, digital wallet, gift card, or store credit.

Citation-friendly rule: Approved refunds go to the original payment method.

Example: If a customer paid with a credit card, an approved refund is returned to that credit card. If a customer paid with store credit, an approved refund is returned as store credit.

Agent handling rule: Explain the refund method only after clarifying that refund approval depends on eligibility, inspection, and support review when applicable.

## [POLICY:INSPECTION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_REFUND] Inspection Before Refund Approval

Northstar Commerce may inspect returned items before approving a refund. Inspection may verify item identity, condition, packaging, accessories, damage claims, and whether the return matches the reason provided.

Citation-friendly rule: Returned items may require inspection before refund approval.

Example: A customer returns headphones for buyer's remorse. Northstar Commerce may inspect that the headphones are unused, unworn, unwashed if applicable, and include original packaging and accessories before approving a refund.

Agent handling rule: If the customer asks whether they will definitely receive a refund, explain that refund approval may depend on inspection.

## [POLICY:RETURN_SHIPPING_CUSTOMER_REASONS] Return Shipping For Customer-Initiated Reasons

Return shipping is not refunded for buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, color preference, duplicate order, or ordered-by-mistake returns. These are customer-initiated reasons.

Citation-friendly rule: Return shipping is not refunded for buyer's remorse, wrong size, changed mind, or ordered by mistake.

Example: A customer returns a sweater because they ordered the wrong size. If the return is otherwise eligible, the original return shipping cost is not refunded under the customer-initiated reason rule.

Agent handling rule: If the reason is customer-initiated, cite this rule when explaining shipping fee responsibility.

## [POLICY:PROOF_OF_PURCHASE_REQUIRED] Proof Of Purchase Requirement

Northstar Commerce requires an order number, receipt, gift receipt, or other proof of purchase for standard returns. Proof of purchase is used to verify the purchase date, delivery date, item price, payment method, and return eligibility.

Citation-friendly rule: A standard return requires an order number or proof of purchase.

Example: A customer who provides an order number can be evaluated under the standard return policy. A customer who cannot provide any proof of purchase may still be reviewed by support, but the agent must not promise a refund.

Agent handling rule: If proof of purchase is missing, ask for an order number, receipt, or gift receipt. If the customer cannot provide proof, classify the case as needing support review rather than eligible.

## [POLICY:STORE_CREDIT_WITH_MISSING_PROOF] Store Credit When Proof Is Missing

When proof of purchase is missing, Northstar Commerce support may approve store credit instead of a refund to the original payment method. Store credit for missing-proof cases is discretionary and requires support approval.

Citation-friendly rule: Store credit may be issued when proof of purchase is missing but support approves.

Example: A customer without a receipt may be routed to support review. Support may approve store credit if the item can be verified and the return is otherwise acceptable.

Agent handling rule: Do not promise store credit. If proof is missing, explain that support review is required and store credit may be possible only if support approves.

## [POLICY:REFUND_TIMING_AFTER_INSPECTION] Refund Timing

Approved refunds are processed 5 to 10 business days after Northstar Commerce receives and inspects the returned item. Bank, card issuer, and payment provider posting times may add additional time after Northstar Commerce processes the refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Refunds are processed 5 to 10 business days after inspection.

Example: If a returned item is inspected on Monday and approved, Northstar Commerce processes the refund within 5 to 10 business days after that inspection date.

Agent handling rule: Do not tell the customer a refund has been issued unless the system has that order status. In this project, the agent should describe policy timing only.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_HIGH_VALUE_REFUNDS] High-Value Refunds Over 500 Dollars

Refund requests over $500 require human support review before approval. High-value cases may require additional identity, order, payment, shipping, and inspection verification.

Citation-friendly rule: Refund requests over $500 require human support review before approval.

Example: A customer requests a $749 refund for an electronics order. Even if the customer provides order details, support review is required before approval.

Agent handling rule: If the customer states or implies the refund value is over $500, set escalation required. If item value is unknown and the product category may be high-value, ask for order value or route to review if other escalation factors are present.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_MISSING_PROOF_HIGH_VALUE] Missing Proof With High-Value Items

Missing proof of purchase for high-value items requires human support review. The agent must not offer refunds, replacements, exchanges, or store credit for high-value items without proof of purchase.

Citation-friendly rule: Missing proof of purchase with high-value items requires human support review.

Example: A customer asks to return expensive headphones but has no receipt, order number, or gift receipt. Support must review before any outcome is offered.

Agent handling rule: Ask for proof of purchase first. If proof remains unavailable and the item appears high-value, escalate.

## [POLICY:STORE_CREDIT_USE] Store Credit Scope

Northstar Commerce store credit may be used for future Northstar Commerce purchases subject to the terms provided when the credit is issued. Store credit is not the same as a cash refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Store credit may be used for future Northstar Commerce purchases and is not a cash refund.

Example: A customer who receives store credit for a gift return can apply that credit to a future purchase from Northstar Commerce.

Agent handling rule: When explaining store credit, distinguish it from original-payment refunds and avoid promising transferability, cash redemption, or expiration terms unless those terms are present in the available policy documents.

## [POLICY:DAMAGED_DEFECTIVE_ITEMS] Damaged Or Defective Items

An item is considered damaged or defective when it arrives broken, unusable, materially flawed, or not functioning as intended. Northstar Commerce may request photos, packaging details, serial numbers, or a description of the defect before deciding on refund, replacement, or return shipping reimbursement.

Citation-friendly rule: Damaged or defective items may require photos, packaging details, serial numbers, or defect descriptions before resolution.

Example: A blender that does not power on after delivery may be treated as defective. Support may ask for the order number, description of the defect, and photos or video before approving next steps.

Agent handling rule: Escalate damaged or defective cases after collecting order number and issue evidence. Do not promise replacement inventory or refund approval.

## [POLICY:DAMAGE_WRONG_MISSING_REQUIRED_INFO] Required Information For Issue Review

Customers reporting damaged, defective, missing, wrong, or not-as-described items must provide an order number, a photo or clear description of the issue, and the issue type. Issue type should be one of damaged, defective, missing item, wrong item, or not as described.

Citation-friendly rule: Issue review requires order number, photo or description, and issue type.

Example: "My lamp arrived broken" is missing the order number and photo or description details. "Order NC-1007 arrived with a broken lamp base, and I can upload a photo" includes the order number, issue type, and supporting description.

Agent handling rule: If any required information is missing, ask for it. If the customer provides enough information, escalate with a handoff summary.

## [POLICY:RETURN_SHIPPING_NORTHSTAR_REASONS] Return Shipping For Northstar Or Fulfillment Issues

Return shipping may be refunded when the return reason is damaged, defective, wrong item, missing item, or not as described. Support review may be required before approving the shipping-fee refund.

Citation-friendly rule: Return shipping may be refunded for damaged, defective, wrong, missing, or not-as-described items.

Example: A customer received the wrong color due to fulfillment error. Support may approve return shipping reimbursement after reviewing the order and issue evidence.

Agent handling rule: If the customer reports a Northstar or fulfillment issue, do not guarantee shipping reimbursement. Explain that return shipping may be refunded after support review.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_LEGAL_THREATS] Legal Threats And Regulatory Claims

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_DAMAGE_RESPONSIBILITY] Unclear Damaged-Item Responsibility

Cases where damaged-item responsibility is unclear require human support review. This includes damage discovered after use, damage reported long after delivery, unclear carrier involvement, unclear customer handling, or conflict between the customer's account and order records.

Citation-friendly rule: Unclear damaged-item responsibility requires human support review.

Example: A customer says a chair broke after several weeks but does not know whether it arrived damaged. Support must review timing, photos, item use, and delivery records before deciding.

Agent handling rule: Escalate and collect delivery date, date issue was noticed, photos or description, package condition, and how the item was used.

## [POLICY:MISSING_ITEMS] Missing Item Claims

A missing item case occurs when an item listed on the order confirmation or packing slip was not included in the delivered package. Missing item cases require order number, item name, package condition, and a description of what was received.

Citation-friendly rule: Missing item claims require order number, item name, package condition, and description of what was received.

Example: A customer ordered three candles but received only two. Support must review the order and fulfillment records before deciding whether to send the missing item or issue a refund.

Agent handling rule: Escalate missing item claims because they may require fulfillment and carrier review. Ask for package condition if the customer did not provide it.

## [POLICY:ESCALATION_AGGRESSIVE_LANGUAGE] Aggressive Or Unsafe Language

Aggressive language, harassment, threats of harm, abusive messages, or unsafe language toward support staff require human review and may require safety handling.

Citation-friendly rule: Aggressive, abusive, threatening, or unsafe language requires human review.

Example: A customer threatens a support employee while demanding a refund. The agent should not continue normal policy negotiation and should escalate.

Agent handling rule: Respond briefly, avoid escalation of tone, and route the case to human review.
